welcome.title: Welcome — I'm Harmony.
welcome.body: I'll help you connect your business to AIOS in a few minutes. I'll ask a little about how you work, recommend the right tools, and set them up for you — no technical setup needed.

business.title: Tell me about your business
business.body: A few quick questions so I can recommend the right setup. There are no wrong answers.

q.type: What kind of business do you run?
q.employees: How many people work with you?
q.channels: How do customers usually reach you?
q.crm: Do you already use a CRM?
q.devices: Do you have printers or scanners to bring in?
q.languages: Which languages do you serve customers in?
q.ai: Which AI providers would you like to use?

recommend.title: Here's what I recommend
recommend.body: Based on your business, these are the tools I'd connect first. Connect what you're ready for — you can always add more later.
recommend.empty: Tell me a bit more about your business and I'll recommend the right tools.

review.title: Review and confirm
review.body: Here's your recommended setup. Connect the rest whenever you're ready.
review.permissions: I only ever request the access each tool needs to do its job, and you can disconnect anything at any time from the Integration Center.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: I'll take it from here — coordinating your tools behind the scenes. Ask me anything, anytime.
